steps.content: Seeing that no one has entered, Sallie pulls out the communicator. The screen flickers, displaying fragmented text... Her hand shakes in terror as she reads it, and the device slips from her grasp. It clatters to the floor with a sharp crack that chills her to the bone.
HELP!! &*$I'm...^#Euphori*#! All devils onboar&*...#&don't want to die... I DON'T WANT TO DIE!!!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: What... is this?

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: A new face... What's your M-value? Your ability?

Sallie thinks of what she's seen on stage. Milly, who could conjure honey out of thin air. Snow, who can control snowflakes. The centaur acrobat, the levitating Selene, and other bizarre figures she couldn't even name.
Their strange abilities and appearances aren't the product of costumes or makeup... They are <color=#fb9259>Sinners</color> with special powers!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...Why are there so many of them here?

In the past, Sinners in DisCity were monsters that even gangs feared. They used their abilities to cause trouble, answering to no one. But now, so many of them are penned up here on this ship... Are they here by choice?
And the guests... are they even human? Why the masks? Those distinguished patrons... who are they? Are they like the rich brats and socialites who used to humiliate her at the clubs in Eastside?
What are they doing here? And who is Mr. E? What kind of place is Euphoria, really? Where is the owner of this communicator? Are they alive? Or... dead?!
What about herself? How much longer does she have?

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Not a Sinner, but quite charming nonetheless, don't you think? With the recent <color=#dg1f1f>departures</color> leaving us short-staffed, we've recruited some exceptional ordinary people to bring a little novelty to the show.
Sallie panics, her mind going numb with fear.

The resentment of being humiliated day after day just to make a living, the shock of discovering her boss was racking up debt in her name, the terror of being cornered by loan sharks, the despair of having no one to help her, no one who saw her plight... She remembers the twisted smiles on their faces when they "introduced" her to this job, the words they used:
She should be grateful for her "good fortune," for "having a pretty face." That they "respected her enough to give her another chance."

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: I never should've come here. I'm better off dead than stuck here... I should've fought to escape, even if they broke my legs!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: No... I don't want to die! I have to think of something...
In her panic, Sallie instinctively grabs the communicator from the floor.
Will it even work? Can she call for help? No. It has to work. She has to call for help. She can't escape this hellhole on her own!

BANG! The dressing room door is thrown open. Sallie jumps in fright, slamming her injured knee into the table and tumbling to the floor. But fear overwhelms the pain as she snatches the communicator and shoves it down her stockings.
She barely has time to do that when a familiar, sweet voice speaks behind her.
Why are you hiding here?
It's Milly. Sallie freezes, her throat too dry to speak.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Are you okay? You're so pale. Did that guest scare you? It's alright, we took care of that for you, so don't be afraid!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Hmm, or are you up to something you don't want the rest of us to know about...? Oh, I know!
She suddenly grabs Sallie's hand, nearly giving her a heart attack.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: You were secretly writing to your sweetheart, weren't you?!
Milly spins in excitement, her skirt blooming like a champagne rose. The cloying sweetness of romance fills the cramped space.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: You reacted so strongly just now, you must have someone you love, right? That's why you refused the guest's affection...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: It must be so scary, having that happen right after you arrived. You must miss him terribly. Tell me all about it! When you're scared, thinking about the one you love always gives you comfort and courage, right?
Sallie is speechless, unsure if Milly is fishing for information or if she's genuinely this simple-minded. Worried the communicator might be discovered, she forces herself to play along.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...Yes. I was... writing my feelings to him...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I knew it! You're just like me!
Milly leans in breathlessly, her big eyes sparkling as she clasps Sallie's hands.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I have someone I love, too! But none of my coworkers like to talk about it. They always make fun of me... You have no idea how happy I am that you're here! I finally have an ally!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Can you tell me your story? I want to hear a real love story! Or should I tell you mine first? My love is amazing. I'm sure you've heard his name.
steps.female_content: Can you tell me your story? I want to hear a real love story! Or should I tell you mine first? My love is amazing. I'm sure you've heard her name.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Oh, look! Here's his picture! Do you recognize him?
steps.female_content: Oh, look! Here's her picture! Do you recognize her?

steps.content: It's a face as weary as her own after pulling back-to-back night shifts.
...Who is it?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Mr. E says he's a celebrity, and it would cause trouble if the guests found out. I don't want to cause any trouble for him, so I'm only showing you. You have to keep it a secret, okay?
steps.female_content: Mr. E says she's a celebrity, and it would cause trouble if the guests found out. I don't want to cause any trouble for her, so I'm only showing you. You have to keep it a secret, okay?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Oh, so gorgeous! No matter how many times I look, I still feel my cheeks blushing!
What's wrong with her? Is she here to mock me? Or is this... just how she is?
What was she talking about? Love? My love story? I don't have...

But an image of a man flashes in her mind, a face that ignites her fury. Milly's incessant chatter is making her feel embarrassed and angry. For a moment, it eclipses her fear. All Sallie wants is for her to shut up.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: If you have someone you love, why do you still entertain the guests?
Milly blinks.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: There's nothing wrong with that. They're all kind guests who request me because they like me.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Nothing wrong with that? Then tell me, what do those kind guests do to you every night?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Do to me? Hehe...
Milly crinkles her eyes, completely unaffected by the sarcasm in Sallie's words. Instead, she gives a sly, mysterious smile.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: They do what you and I are doing right now, of course... sharing their <color=#fb9259>love stories</color> with me!
Sallie's confusion can no longer keep up with Milly's romantic fancy.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Every guest who requests me comes with a sincere heart. They tell me all about their feelings for their love far away, about loves they've lost, their happiness, regrets, so many things.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: People captured by love are always so fragile. I just sit and listen. Sometimes I pass them tissues, sometimes I give them water...

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...They don't touch you?
Now it's Milly's turn to be confused.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Why would they? I'm not the one they love.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Everyone knows I'm just here to sing and dance and make the guests happy. No one would really fall in love with a pretty flower decorating the stage. Besides, I've already told them that my heart belongs to someone else.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: It's because my love is so brave and honest that everyone is willing to share things with me that they wouldn't tell anyone else.

Milly's face is gentle, but Sallie finds it ridiculous. So this is "the Jewel of Euphoria." She overestimated this woman. A Sinner, maybe, but she's just a love-addled fool. How comical. Pathetic, really. And she's beginning to understand the boss's methods.

For these patrons, beauty that is so readily attained becomes cheap and disposable. Perhaps what these cold-blooded guests really crave is the true affection that they so lack, something they can use to tout their own virtue.

After all, this place offers a feast where they can gorge themselves to their heart's content, or play at some charade of pure love. Finding a genuinely foolish romantic like Milly must not have been easy. Mr. E must have invested considerable effort in shaping her.
...How absurd. Those bastards come to a place like this to seek thrills. How dare they pretend to care about love or affection?!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: The ones who go on and on about how deeply they love or how wounded they are—they're either wallowing in self-pity or trying to get in your pants. Those scumbags know exactly what they're doing. The second you start to feel sorry for them, you're finished. You'll get played, sooner or later.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: No. No one has ever tried anything with me.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: They've never laid a hand on you?
Milly shakes her head.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Never forced themselves on you?
Milly shakes her head again. Then, as if realizing something, she reaches out and grasps Sallie's hand with concern. Startled, Sallie tries to pull away.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Sallie, you really are scared. Do you think everyone out there is going to hurt you? Did someone hurt you?
Milly looks at her with a pity that only fuels Sallie's growing irritation.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I know that feeling. Don't worry, it'll be okay. You're stronger than you think. Think about the person you love. That will give you the courage to keep going.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: And until your love comes to find you, I'll be by your side to help you. Trust me. No matter how hopeless things seem, love will protect your heart from harm.
She speaks with genuine sincerity, but Sallie can't bear to hear it anymore. There are certain things that will always set a cornered cat on edge.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Someone I love? I don't have anyone like that! And I can't take this for another second! I'm leaving this wretched place!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Leaving...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: You said... you want to leave here...
Milly's face darkens. Sallie realizes, too late, what she's done. Her stomach tightens. She's said too much.

Damn it... she's tricked by this love-addled girl into forgetting one most important thing: this sweetheart is Mr. E's favorite. After everything she's said, will Milly betray her? Is she going to be killed now?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Are you going to elope?! Oh my god, that's so brave! So romantic! The power of love!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Do you even use your damn brain?!
Sallie explodes. Grabbing Milly by the shoulders, she tries to shake some sense into her.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: I'm trying to escape! Do you get it? ES-CAPE!!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I get it, I get it! That's why I want to help, otherwise you—

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: I don't need it! I don't want anything to do with any of you! I'll get out on my own! I—
What are you talking about?
There was no sound from the door, no footsteps. Mr. E is standing in the doorway, watching them with a smile. Sallie's burning rage turns to ice.
The communicator in her stocking digs uncomfortably into her leg. She remembers the text on the screen, and with it, a deep, primal fear.
HELP!! &*$I'm...^#Euphori*#! All devils onboar&*...#&don't want to die... I DON'T WANT TO DIE!!!

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Please, go on. Is it something I'm not supposed to hear?
The man's smile is venomous as a serpent's, its tongue about to coil around its prey...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Of course not! We were talking about Sallie's love letter!
The blonde girl steps between them, giggling like she's oblivious to the icy tension in the air.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Why did you have to barge in, Mr. E? Sallie's so shy, and I finally got her to open up a little. Then you came in, and look, she's clammed up again.
She puffs out her cheeks in mock indignation, but it comes across as nothing more than sweet, playful pouting. The trick works wonders. Mr. E's expression softens back into a warm smile.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: My apologies. I thought you were arguing, but it turns out you're already friends...
Sallie looks down, rubbing her arms nervously and avoiding Mr. E's gaze. But he's already dismissed her.
He simply smiles, reaching out to stroke Milly's golden hair.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: The show's about to start, so go get ready. Give them another perfect performance. Make them remember you. It'll bring you one step closer to your lover.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I will. And so will Sallie. We both have someone to think about. At least, she won't trip again.
Mr. E nods, but as he turns to leave, he pauses in the doorway.
The light throws his cold, slender silhouette into sharp relief, his delicate features lost in shadow.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: By the way, Sallie. Do try your best. You have fans now.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Should another guest request you, be sure to cherish the opportunity.
Sallie stands frozen to the spot. She remembers the gold mask, the man's hands, his eyes, his words. She shakes her head violently, trying to dispel the creeping fear.
